style: 3D animated satire, deadpan; vertical, full-bleed, pangolin fills two thirds of frame height every beat
subject: ONE stocky pangolin, navy suit, copper scales, long claws; scales on his forearm are his keycards
second_characters: ONE emerald praying mantis guard, a real insect: triangular head, compound eyes, thin forelegs, peaked cap; workers with coffee pass at the lens
props: two identical copper scales; glass turnstiles with swinging glass flaps, round scanners glowing only green or red
environment: crowded office lobby, row of glass turnstiles, elevator lights behind
lighting: bright day, hard sunlight from left rims his scales, warm elevator glow from right, scanner glow on his face, high contrast
motion_rule: Camera orbits the pangolin on a tight arc and never stops; he moves every beat: sidestepping, springing sideways, spinning on his heel, circling the turnstile posts; side characters act at the lens, never across his mouth. New shot size every beat.

audio.pacing: brisk, each line once, inside its beat

timeline.a: mouth opens on every syllable; mid-shot, arc starts front-left; stepping to the turnstile he plucks one copper scale off his forearm, it glints in the foreground
mouth opens on every syllable; waist-up, he slaps the scale on the scanner mid-stride, green glow, the flaps swing open and he is through; flaps hit the frame edges
knee-up, he swings his body to the next identical turnstile, drops scale one into his breast pocket, tail sweeping wide; a worker with coffee crosses the frame edge at the lens
chest-up, he rises on hind legs, winces, plucks a second identical scale off his forearm
mouth opens on every syllable; medium shot, he steps and slaps the second scale on the scanner with the same gesture
mouth opens on every syllable; close-up, on hind legs he leans in and yanks his claw back as the scanner sucks the scale in with a crunch, red glow
mouth opens on every syllable; hips-up, arc right; he shakes his stung claw and sidesteps two short steps left on hind legs, scales bristling
chest-up, arc on; the scanner spits copper shards in a red flash onto his snout; he springs sideways right, away from the turnstile
knee-up, arc on; he spins on his heel and strides round the turnstile post in a tight loop, tail swinging wide
head and shoulders; the shards on his snout make him sneeze, the sneeze jolts him a full step back; a shard plinks into the coffee cup of a worker passing in the foreground
waist-up, arc left; the mantis guard reaches in from the near frame edge at the lens, taps his shoulder with a thin foreleg; he whirls to face it, stepping back sideways
chest-up, arc on; he shoulders the mantis aside and slaps a paw over the bare patch on his forearm
face and paw, arc slows in front; paw held on the patch, he turns his head into the lens, blinks once, mouth shut, scales clattering flat down his body

must_appear: two identical scales; scale one opens the flaps; scale two, same gesture, eaten by the scanner, shards spat out; final: his calm gaze in the lens, paw on the bare patch
negative_prompt: horizontal frame, wide shot, small hero, static camera, human guard, duplicate pangolins, extra scales in his paws, curled up, crouching in place, text, letters, digits, subtitles, watermark, floating objects, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, a line said twice, speech after 6.0, landscape, letterbox, empty background, duplicate props
